summary.prose: This Story gives the code review its material: every changed symbol in a dimension's grounding becomes one whole atom, related to the others by calls, a shared file and a shared directory, and a symbol held in another chunk is described by a short deterministic line. Two pure functions do the work; the code-review adapter then hands them to s1's prepare, so a review over the limit is divided along the lines of the code while a review under it sends exactly today's prompt. Chunk prompts, obligations and gather remain Story s3's.

tasks.title: codeReviewMaterial: atoms and relations from a dimension's grounding
tasks.summary: Add codeReviewMaterial(grounding) in src/workflow/review-pipeline/adapters/code-review-material.ts: one whole atom per ChangedSymbolSummary in grounding order (id entityId, label file#name, file, module = the file's directory or '.', text = the row's JSON); 'calls' relations by name either direction (a name matching several rows relates to each, no self-relation, an unmatched name gives none); 'same-file' and 'same-module' relations; obligations empty and context absent. A duplicate entityId throws, naming it and both labels. Pure and deterministic.
acceptanceChecks: Every row of the grounding is exactly one atom with the specified id, label, file, module and text.
Calls, same-file and same-module relations follow the contract, including same-named rows, self-calls, unmatched names and diff-review rows.
A duplicate entityId raises an error naming it; the same grounding always gives identical material.

tasks.title: Point the code-review adapter at the material and the neighbour summary
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/review-pipeline/code-review.ts, each dimension adapter's material() returns codeReviewMaterial of the dimension's prepared grounding read from the snapshot (coverage: prepareCoverageGrounding's output; the others: the grounding itself) and its neighbourSummary member uses t2's writer. Under the limit the single-chunk path and today's prompts are unchanged. Integration tests drive s1's prepare with a small limit and a chunk-call fixture rendering a chunk's rows in the prompt's array form: grouping order, neighbour summaries on both sides of a cut relation (s1's logged last resort excepted), whole atoms, every rendered chunk call within the limit, and an oversized atom named (judged neighbour-free).
acceptanceChecks: Over the limit, symbols that call each other share a chunk before those only sharing a file, and those before those only sharing a directory.

A call relation cut between chunks gives each side a neighbour summary of the other, except s1's logged last resort: a symbol that cannot hold its call summaries beside it is kept whole, the summaries that do not fit are left out of its call and the omission is logged; the other side still carries the symbol's summary.
Every symbol is whole in exactly one chunk, every rendered chunk call fits, and a symbol too large alone is named before any provider call.
Under the limit the plan is one chunk and the dimension prompt is today's.
A row whose JSON fits the limit but whose rendered singleton call does not raises AtomTooLargeError before any provider call.

An atom whose singleton call with every same-directory line exceeds the limit is packed and not reported as too large: same-file and same-directory lines are context (s1's amended prepare), added only while they fit.
Coverage material is built from prepareCoverageGrounding: only eligible rows, each carrying its coverageEvidence.
